reasoning: The Inference Payload Processor (IPP) is a long-running Envoy External Processing (ext-proc) gRPC data-plane service. It runs next to the inference gateway's proxy, inspects and changes request/response payloads, and handles payload-aware routing (multi-pool and LoRA routing, model selection). It is built as a single binary (cmd/main.go -> runner) with a Dockerfile, and it ships a Helm chart (config/charts) and kustomize manifests (deploy/) that create a Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, RBAC, and an Istio EnvoyFilter or GKE GCPRoutingExtension. It uses controller-runtime, but only to run the process and watch ConfigMaps for plugin configuration (a single configmap_reconciler in a plugin). It defines no CRDs that it reconciles and manages no resource lifecycles, so it is not an operator. The apix/config package defines a YAML PayloadProcessorConfig file format, not a Kubernetes API that gets reconciled. Its plugin framework can be extended, but the main deliverable is a deployable network service, not a library.
